name: Hushai
whenBasis: In David's reign, ≈1010–970 BC, counted back from Solomon as Thiele and most chronologies do.
summary: Hushai the Archite, called the king's friend, who met David on the Mount of Olives with his robe torn and dust on his head. David sent him back to Jerusalem to pretend loyalty to Absalom and defeat Ahithophel's counsel. He persuaded Absalom to gather all Israel before attacking, which gave David time, and sent word to David by the priests' sons.
body: Absalom asks whether this is his loyalty to his friend; Hushai answers that he will serve whom the LORD and the people have chosen.

His speech paints David as a bear robbed of her cubs and his men as warriors who will not be caught unprepared, and flatters Absalom with the picture of all Israel as the sand of the sea with him at their head.
